correctness.rationale: For theta>=1 both hazard derivatives are strictly positive. For 0<theta<1 all stationary ages lie before x0; the log ratio Q/G has a derivative strictly convex on its only possible zero region, via an explicit positive second derivative of -G'/G. Thus its horizontal level intersections are at most three. A logistic-peak concentration constructs three for every shape. The exact-rational checker validates a concrete witness with four alternate sign enclosures; the infinite bound is analytical.

value.rationale: An exact sharp maximum number of hazard reversals, attained robustly for each 0<theta<1, is an intrinsically motivated shape invariant of a reliability distribution introduced to model nonmonotone failure rates. It quantifies exactly what regimes the established model can and cannot express, including a two-minimum/one-maximum pattern not captured by the usual bathtub descriptor.
